description: OHLC bars for 123 indexes: S&P 500 (SPX), Nasdaq-100 (NDX), Dow (DJI), Russell 2000 (RUT), VIX and its term structure (VIX9D, VIX3M, VIX6M, VIX1Y, VVIX, SKEW), sector and style indexes, DAX, AEX, the dollar index (DXY), Treasury yield indexes (TNX, FVX, TYX) and more. interval: 1min, 5min, 15min, 30min, 1hour or 1day (default). Times are US Eastern. Clipped to as_of. Free keys get daily bars for the last 12 months; paid keys get every bar size.

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).

symbol.description: Index symbol, e.g. SPX, NDX, VIX, RUT, DXY.

name: get_index
title: Get index bars (SPX, NDX, VIX, ...)
